testimonials.text: Our trip was absolutely amazing! Every detail was perfectly planned and we got to explore places we had only dreamed of. Highly recommend Wanderly!

testimonials.text: Wanderly made our vacation truly unforgettable. From seamless bookings to 24/7 support, everything was top-notch. Can't wait for our next adventure!

testimonials.text: The team at Wanderly is amazing! They customized our itinerary perfectly and gave us the best travel experience. Thank you for the memories!

faqs.question: What documents do I need to travel internationally?
faqs.answer: When traveling internationally, you typically need essential documents such as a valid passport, visa (if required by your destination country), travel itinerary, proof of accommodation, and return or onward tickets. Make sure your passport is valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates.

faqs.question: How can I book a tour package?
faqs.answer: You can easily book a tour package through our website. Simply select your desired destination, choose your travel dates, and follow the booking process. Our support team is also available to assist you via phone or email.

faqs.question: What is included in the tour package price?
faqs.answer: Our tour packages generally include accommodation, guided tours, some meals, and local transportation as specified in the itinerary. Flights and personal expenses are typically not included unless stated otherwise.

faqs.question: What is your cancellation and refund policy?
faqs.answer: Cancellations made 30 days prior to departure receive a full refund minus processing fees. Cancellations within 30 days may incur charges. Please refer to our detailed Terms and Conditions for specific refund structures.

faqs.question: How do I know if my booking is confirmed?
faqs.answer: Once your payment is successfully processed, you will receive an immediate email confirmation with your booking reference and detailed itinerary.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, Amex), PayPal, and direct bank transfers.

faqs.question: Can I customize my tour package?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer tailored experiences. Contact our travel experts and they will help you customize your itinerary to match your preferences and budget.

faqs.question: Do you offer travel insurance?
faqs.answer: We highly recommend travel insurance. While we do not provide it directly, we can guide you to trusted partners who offer comprehensive coverage for our travelers.

faqs.question: What should I do if I need to change my booking?
faqs.answer: Please contact our support team as soon as possible. We will do our best to accommodate changes, subject to availability and potential change fees from airlines or hotels.

sections.title: The Beauty Of Sustainable Paradise

sections.title: Experience Green Luxury
paragraphs: You can enjoy world-class comfort while knowing your stay supports environmental conservation. Choose eco-friendly resorts and be part of the movement for a greener future.

quote.text: Sustainable travel isn't just a trend; it's a responsibility. The Maldives shows us how to cherish nature while enjoying its beauty.

paragraphs: You can enjoy world-class comfort while knowing your stay supports environmental conservation. Choose eco-friendly resorts and be part of the movement for a greener future.

quote.text: Sustainable travel isn't just a trend; it's a responsibility. The Maldives shows us how to cherish nature while enjoying its beauty.
quote.author: Jane Cooper

ecoInitiatives.description: Innovative systems collect and purify rainwater for various uses.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.content: We collect personal information that you provide to us, such as your name, email address, phone number, and payment details when you book a trip or contact us.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.content: Your information helps us provide and improve our services, process bookings and payments, communicate with you, and personalize your travel experience.

sections.title: 3. Information Sharing
sections.content: We do not sell or rent your personal information. We may share your data with trusted partners and service providers only to complete your bookings.

sections.title: 4. Data Security

sections.title: 5. Your Rights
